"""Round 2: update rock properties along lower water-supply connections."""
from datetime import datetime
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import numpy as np

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(1, str(ROOT.parent))
from compositional_tools import fields
from spatial_tools import native_fields, well_region, path_region
from field_edit import save_candidate

parent = "round1_k_only"
base = fields(ROOT / "candidates" / parent)
indices, xyz, connections = native_fields()
sw0 = np.fromfile(ROOT / "runs/baseline_tuned/initial_ImmiscibleSaturation.bin")
volume = np.fromfile(ROOT / "runs/baseline_tuned/volumes.bin")
paths = np.load(ROOT / "topology/bottom_completion_paths.npz")
oil = sw0 < .99
safe = base["PORO"].ravel()[indices] * volume > 1e-3
log_h = np.zeros(len(indices))
log_z = np.zeros(len(indices))
log_phi = np.zeros(len(indices))

# Observations for the full history are known. Simulation feedback covers only the first 1488 days that have finished. Full-period validation remains pending.
controls = {
    "P11": {"kh": 1., "kz": 3., "phi": .75},
    "P12": {"kh": 2.5, "kz": 2., "phi": .70},
    "P13": {"kh": 1., "kz": 2., "phi": .85},
    "P14": {"kh": 3., "kz": 2., "phi": .50},
    "P15": {"kh": 5., "kz": 3., "phi": .55},
    "P16": {"kh": 8., "kz": 1., "phi": .65},
}
for well, control in controls.items():
    path_weight = path_region(xyz, paths[well], horizontal_radius_m=220, vertical_radius_m=30)
    log_z += np.log(control["kz"]) * path_weight
    log_phi += np.log(control["phi"]) * path_weight * oil * safe
    if well in {"P14", "P15", "P16"}:
        deepest = connections.loc[connections.well == well, "z"].max()
        near = well_region(xyz, connections, well, radius_m=220, vertical_padding_m=45)
        lower = .5 * (1 + np.tanh((xyz[2] - (deepest - 60.)) / 20.))
        # Cover the lower part of the deepest completion and the bottom-water connection. Apply the multiplier only once where the two regions overlap.
        horizontal_weight = np.maximum(path_weight, near * lower)
    else:
        horizontal_weight = path_weight
    log_h += np.log(control["kh"]) * horizontal_weight

changed = {}
for key, factor in [("PERMX", np.exp(log_h)), ("PERMY", np.exp(log_h)),
                    ("PERMZ", np.exp(log_z)), ("PORO", np.exp(log_phi))]:
    value = base[key].copy()
    value.ravel()[indices] *= factor
    changed[key] = value

rationale = {
    "decision_time": datetime.now().isoformat(),
    "objective": "Full-period field FOPR/FWPR and well WOPR/WWPR. Pressure and gas production are diagnostic; the end of history receives the same weighting as other periods.",
    "feedback_evidence": "round1_oil_water_partial_comparison.json: actual simulated responses through the common day 1488 and the near-well Sw field at the same time.",
    "known_history_window": "All 2891 days of observations were available. The experiment used no strict blind or holdout evaluation.",
    "parent_version": parent,
    "inherited_permeability": "Start from the round-one permeability-only input. The near-well horizontal permeability reduction was originally suggested by pressure diagnostics. Judge its retention using oil and water only; the pressure improvement is outside the score.",
    "additional_central_multipliers": controls,
    "porosity_multiplier_basis": "Relative to the original porosity. The porosity in the parent round1_k_only is the same as the baseline.",
    "permeability_multiplier_basis": "Relative to parent round1_k_only and applied on top of its existing edits. These are additional multipliers, rather than totals relative to the original field.",
    "p14_rationale": "On day 1488 the water rate was 199.82 m3/day against 862.36 observed. Water was already present in eight lower completion cells. Test the fraction of lower-zone inflow and vertical water propagation. First water arrival preceded injection.",
    "p15_rationale": "On day 1488 the water rate was 45.96 m3/day against 318.78 observed. Sw rose mainly in three lower completion cells. Increase lower-zone horizontal inflow capacity and vertical connectivity and reduce hydrocarbon-bearing pore volume along the path.",
    "p16_rationale": "On day 1488 the water rate was 18.91 m3/day against 252.49 observed. Sw at the deepest completion was approximately 0.326. The previous minimum-resistance path to any completion missed the deepest water-entry layer. The discrete path to the deepest completion has four cells, all in layer K219. Increase permeability along that path and Kh in the lower zone.",
    "low_water_cut_well_rationale": "Near day 1488 the observed P11/P12 water rates were 14.20/26.10 m3/day and the simulations gave 0.53/0.31. Modestly accelerate deep bottom-water arrival. P13 is close at this point but water rises later, so use a weaker edit and check for premature arrival over the complete history.",
    "path_type": "Use shortest static paths with cost 1/T on actual positive-transmissibility connections to locate candidate regions. Evaluate them using simulated Sw and timing since the static paths are not verified dynamic streamlines.",
    "region": "Use a 3D Gaussian around the bottom-water path to the deepest completion, with horizontal and vertical scales of 220 m and 30 m and zero weight beyond three scales. At wet wells, use a 20 m tanh transition over the lower 60 m and a 220 m horizontal Gaussian. Combine regions by maximum weight to avoid multiplying overlaps twice.",
    "porosity_constraints": "Edit only active cells with initial Sw < 0.99 and cell pore volume > 1e-3 m3. Retain pore volume in pure-water cells.",
    "initial_composition": "Retain the original normalized composition. This round makes no composition edit to fit the gas-oil ratio. Fractions still sum to one in every cell.",
    "fixed_items": "Retain the well controls, liquid rate, initial pressure and Sw, temperature, EOS, SCAL, grid and simulator source.",
    "pore_volume_original_m3": float(np.sum(base["PORO"].ravel()[indices] * volume)),
    "pore_volume_edited_m3": float(np.sum(changed["PORO"].ravel()[indices] * volume)),
    "completion_criteria": "Rerun all 516 intervals over 2891 days from t0. Compute the primary score after native input and report-state checks pass.",
}
path = save_candidate("round2_oil_water", changed, rationale, parent=parent)
(ROOT / "round2_decision.json").write_text(json.dumps(rationale, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
print("Saved:", path)
print(json.dumps(rationale, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

"""Invoke the existing original Julia/JutulDarcy installation provided by the user. Write only experiment logs and results to the workspace."""
import argparse
from datetime import datetime
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
WORKSPACE = ROOT.parents[2]
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("name")
parser.add_argument("script", type=Path)
parser.add_argument("arguments", nargs="*")
parser.add_argument("--threads", type=int, default=8)
args = parser.parse_args()
config = json.loads((WORKSPACE / "jutuldarcy-setup/network-files/Runtime-Config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
out = ROOT / "logs" / args.name
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
env = os.environ.copy()
env.update(JULIA_DEPOT_PATH=config["DepotPath"] + ";", JULIA_LOAD_PATH="@;@stdlib",
           JULIA_PKG_PRECOMPILE_AUTO="0", JULIA_NUM_THREADS=str(args.threads),
           OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="4")
command = [config["JuliaExecutable"], "--startup-file=no",
           "--project=" + config["NetworkRoot"] + "\\environment",
           str(args.script.resolve()), *args.arguments]
start = time.monotonic()
with (out / "simulation_log.txt").open("w", encoding="utf-8") as log:
    process = subprocess.Popen(command, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    (out / "launch_record.json").write_text(json.dumps({"launch_time": datetime.now().isoformat(), "PID": process.pid,
        "command": command}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print("Julia started. Log:" + str(out), flush=True)
    for raw in iter(process.stdout.readline, b""):
        line = raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        log.write(line)
        log.flush()
    code = process.wait()
(out / "exit_record.json").write_text(json.dumps({"exit_code": code, "elapsed_seconds": time.monotonic()-start},
    ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
print("Julia finished. Exit code: " + str(code), flush=True)
print((out / "simulation_log.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8")[-12000:])
sys.exit(code)

"""Compare only the explicitly identified common partial window. This script does not produce full-history scores."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.font_manager import FontProperties

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT.parent))
from compositional_tools import history

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("diagnostics", nargs="+", help="name=read-only_diagnostic_directory_name")
parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
obs = history().query("kind == 'producer'").copy()
obs["end_days"] = obs.end_days.round(6)
frames = {}
for argument in args.diagnostics:
    name, folder = argument.split("=", 1)
    path = ROOT / folder
    raw = pd.read_csv(path / "well_results_si.csv")
    raw = raw[raw.variable.isin(["orat", "wrat"])].pivot(
        index=["time_days", "well"], columns="variable", values="value_si").reset_index()
    raw["end_days"] = raw.time_days.round(6)
    raw["qo_sim"] = -86400 * raw.orat
    raw["qw_sim"] = -86400 * raw.wrat
    matched = obs.merge(raw, on=["end_days", "well"], validate="one_to_one")
    matched["primary"] = (matched.status == "OPEN") & (matched.qo_obs + matched.qw_obs > 1e-6)
    matched.to_csv(path / "matched_oil_water_partial.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8")
    frames[name] = matched
cutoff = min(frame.end_days.max() for frame in frames.values())
keys = None
for frame in frames.values():
    current = set(map(tuple, frame.loc[frame.end_days <= cutoff, ["end_days", "well"]].to_numpy()))
    if keys is None:
        keys = current
    else:
        assert keys == current, "The shared history times are incomplete. Only matching time windows may be compared."
result = {"partial_window_only": True, "common_end_day": float(cutoff), "history_duration_days": float(obs.end_days.max()), "comparison": {}}
for name, frame in frames.items():
    frame = frame[frame.end_days <= cutoff]
    frames[name] = frame
    active = frame[frame.primary]
    metrics = {}
    for well, group in active.groupby("well"):
        error = group[["qo_sim", "qw_sim"]].to_numpy() - group[["qo_obs", "qw_obs"]].to_numpy()
        metrics[well] = {"valid_samples": len(group), "oil_rmse_m3_day": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(error[:, 0]**2))),
                         "water_rmse_m3_day": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(error[:, 1]**2)))}
    field = frame.groupby("end_days")[["qo_obs", "qw_obs", "qo_sim", "qw_sim"]].sum()
    field_error = field[["qo_sim", "qw_sim"]].to_numpy() - field[["qo_obs", "qw_obs"]].to_numpy()
    result["comparison"][name] = {"per_well": metrics, "field_oil_rmse_m3_day": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(field_error[:, 0]**2))),
                            "field_water_rmse_m3_day": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(field_error[:, 1]**2)))}
